note: Window agent m5000-m4901: one event clearing 11 leftover Alfold specks of the Linear Pottery culture after 4940 BCE.

region.text: the Alföld cells that the county-level region of ledger event 7 misses: the Pest plain and the city units of Szeged, Szolnok, Kecskemét and Békéscsaba, plus the Bihor (Crișana) plain edge

events.note: 4940 BCE: the Alföld Linear Pottery ends: the classical Alföld culture of the LBK "flourished until about 4940" on the Hungarian Alföld, the great plain. Ledger event 7 names the counties, but 11 Alföld cells (6 in Pest, 1 each in the units of Szeged, Szolnok, Kecskemét and Békéscsaba, 1 in Bihor) stay with the Linear Pottery in the draft as isolated specks until 4500; they leave with the rest of the Alföld.
